dedupe_keys.name: cropwat 8 0 crop and irrigation water requirement program fao

description: CROPWAT is a decision support program from the Land and Water Development Division of FAO for calculating crop water requirements and irrigation requirements from soil, climate and crop data. It develops irrigation schedules for different management conditions, calculates scheme water supply for varying crop patterns, evaluates farmers' irrigation practices and estimates crop performance under rainfed and irrigated conditions, following FAO Irrigation and Drainage Papers 56 and 33. Version 8.0 for Windows adds daily and decade calculations, rice and paddy procedures, daily soil water balance tables and a multilingual interface in English, Spanish, French and Russian. Coverage is any location; standard crop and soil data are included and climate for over 5,000 stations comes from the CLIMWAT database. It is a free download from the FAO page. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): FAO terms: statistical databases fall under the FAO Open Data Licensing Policy and Statistical Databases Terms of Use (licence of this database not named on the pages read). Simulation uses: irrigation demand and scheme supply for capacity planning and drought adaptation. Related records: AquaCrop (model-fao-aquacrop) and AQUASTAT (data-fao-aquastat-main-database). The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
inputs: Climate (monthly, decade or daily), soil and crop data; climate for over 5,000 stations from the CLIMWAT database when local data are lacking
